data.name: Warharvest RTS
data.detailed_description:
Command epic mass battles in a 3D pixel-art medieval fantasy RTS. Lead one of four factions, each fighting by its own laws of war. Raise war hosts of infantry, cavalry, and siege engines, choose powerful techs, storm enemy strongholds, and fight across battlefields alive with objectives. Play solo PvE against AI, or PvP with up to 8 players.

FROM OUTPOST TO WAR HOST

The war never waits. While your soldiers hold the front, your halls are already filling with new ranks — fresh squads marching out of the gates, cavalry wheeling into line, siege engines rolling up the road. The camp you founded at dawn becomes a war host by dusk. And across the map, so does your enemy's.

POWERFUL TECHS. TURN THE TIDE.

Choose powerful techs to strengthen your forces, push your faction's strengths further, and turn the tide of battle.

THE BATTLEFIELD TEMPTS YOU

Beyond your walls, the map is full of temptation. Caravans heavy with gold crawl past your borders. Captive soldiers wait for rescue. Neutral camps sleep on their treasures. Take them and grow rich — hesitate, and the enemy will. The richest lord is the one who dares to leave home.

FOUR FACTIONS. FOUR RULES OF WAR.

HUMANS — STRENGTH BUILDS FAITH. Every soldier under the Human banner makes the Faith flow faster — and Faith feeds the war machine. A wheel that turns faster the bigger it grows. Steady expansion, disciplined ranks, an answer for every formation. Humans do not win with tricks. They win with mass, armor, and momentum.

ELVES — SEE FIRST. STRIKE FIRST. The forest watches with them. Elves fight through range, speed, and sight — they find you first, strike from strength, and never let the battle reach their lines. Where the forest still stands, their power grows; the woods are not scenery, they are walls. Come with axes, and the forest itself will answer.

THE UNDEAD — DEATH BUILDS THE ARMY. An Undead army begins fragile and ends inevitable. Spread corruption across the land, and the enemy's dead rise beneath your banner. Every battle makes the legion larger — win or lose. Make the war long. Make it costly. Drown them in the soldiers they killed.

ORCS — FURY MUST KEEP MOVING. Orc strength is fury, and fury feeds on blood. Every blow struck, every wound taken, every enemy felled makes them hit harder — and the storm dies the moment they stand still. So an Orc host never stands still. Keep pushing. Keep swinging. Give the enemy no room to breathe.

NO WAR PLAYS OUT THE SAME

Every battlefield is generated anew — its own rivers, forests, and openings to seize. And the enemy across the map fights by different laws than you do. Plans rarely survive twice. Adapt, improvise, and find the shape of this war.

KEY FEATURES

  • Four Factions, Four Laws of War — Humans, Elves, the Undead, and Orcs grow their power in fundamentally different ways.

  • Powerful Techs — strengthen your forces, push your faction's strengths further, and turn the tide of battle.

  • Epic Mass Battles — armies form fast and fights stay large. Command the war, not the waiting.

  • A Living Battlefield — caravans, camps, and rescues pull every army beyond its walls.

  • Classic RTS Warfare — build, gather, expand, defend, and break the enemy's stronghold.

  • Every War a New Map — procedurally generated battlefields.

  • Solo PvE & Up to 8-Player PvP — face the AI alone or wage war against rivals.

  • A 3D Pixel-Art Fantasy World — Lead large armies across medieval battlefields.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 2 GB / AMD Radeon R9 270 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for online multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 4 GB / AMD Radeon RX 570 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for online multiplayer.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 quad-core or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU or Metal-capable Intel/AMD GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio output
  • Additional Notes: Supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Broadband Internet connection required for online multiplayer.
mac_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M2 or Intel Core i7 quad-core or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro / M2 GPU or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio output
